title: SymPhase: magnetic and spin-group symmetry, symmetry-allowed conductivity tensors and convex-hull phase stability for VASP
description:
SymPhase reads VASP calculations (POSCAR, INCAR, OUTCAR, OSZICAR) and determines the crystal and magnetic space groups and the non-relativistic spin group, classifying ferromagnets, antiferromagnets and altermagnets with their spin-splitting form (s-, d-, g-, i-wave). It derives the symmetry-allowed charge, spin and orbital conductivity tensors, separated into time-reversal-even and -odd parts, including unconventional spin-orbit-torque channels and the components that exist only with spin-orbit coupling.

From a list of elements alone it collects the known phases from OQMD or the Materials Project, builds the convex hull for any number of elements (energies above hull, decompositions, publication-quality figures), writes VASP inputs with a SLURM job array and runs in parallel on many cores or with MPI. Tutorials, self-checking quizzes and a presentation are included.
